state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 4.** `nvs-config` reads `[ldap.<name>]` and `[capabilities.ldap]`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs` opens connections (`connect`, `open`) and runs `who_am_i`, `search` and `read`. `Core\Ldap::connect`/`open` are registered with six server-free cases. `nvs_ldap::Filter::Encoded` and `nvs_ldap::is_attribute_description` are on `main`.

**A `.nvst` case can now copy a repository file beside itself**: `--COPY--`, one path per line relative to the case's directory, `..` allowed, landing under its last segment. A missing source skips the case and names the file (`crates/nvs-test/src/lib.rs` section table). A samba-backed case writes `--COPY--\n../../db/ca.crt` and `tls_ca_file = "ca.crt"` in its `--FILE nvs.toml--`.

**The members are written and wait on branch `ldap-stage4-members`** (one commit on top of `cd9b49179`, stdlib files only: `instance.rs`, `ldap/mod.rs`, `ldap/registry.rs`, `ldap/search.rs`, `registry.rs`). It registers `Ldap\Connection::whoami`/`search`/`read`, `Ldap\Entries`, `Ldap\Entry` (`dn`, `has`, `string`, `strings`, `bytes`), `Ldap\Filter` (`equals`, `present`) and `Ldap\Scope`. A probe against `samba-ad` printed the right answers for each. It is not on `main` because `conformance_coverage.rs` needs three `.nvst` cases per new member (10 members) plus a case or an "unreachable from source" comment for every `Fault` site in `search.rs`.

`dn()` returns `string` until `Dn` exists (Stage 5). `toArray` and `Entries::references` are not written. `Ldap\Settings` still lacks `base` and `tlsCaFile`.

items.text: **Land branch `ldap-stage4-members` and its server-free cases**: `git cherry-pick -n ldap-stage4-members`, so it commits with its cases after verify. Once that commit is on `main`, delete the branch with `git branch -d`, and if it says the branch is not merged, use `git branch -D` only after `git diff ldap-stage4-members main -- crates/nvs-stdlib` shows nothing. Write the cases that need no server: a tainted DN or `base` does not compile, a tainted `select` name does not compile, `Filter::equals` accepts a tainted value, a bad attribute name throws `LogicError`. Add an assertion or an "unreachable from source" comment for each `Fault` site in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs:68`. ADR 0278 § 1, § 5 and § 6.

**The samba-backed cases**: the acceptance case `tests/conformance/core/ldap-connect-and-search.nvst` and the rest of three per member of `Ldap\Connection`, `Ldap\Entry`, `Ldap\Filter` and `Ldap\Entries`, each with `--COPY--\n../../db/ca.crt` (`crates/nvs-test/src/run.rs:197`) and a `--SKIPIF--` for a missing server. ADR 0278 § 1 and § 5.
**`Entry::toArray` and `Entries::references`** (ADR 0278 § 1 and § 5) in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs` and `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:205`, each with three cases.
